data.name: Aviny
data.gender_notes: Aviny is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aviny is a Sanskrit name derived from the goddess Avani, who is believed to be the giver of life and nourishment. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted as the goddess of fertility and prosperity. This name carries the blessings of abundance, growth, and vitality. The name Aviny carries the meaning “Goddess Avani, giver of life” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Aviny usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess avani, giver of life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessing of the abundant and nourishing goddess Avani.
data.etymology: Aviny belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Avani, giver of life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aviny total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
